svg.title: National compute programs and their stated sizes
svg.desc: World map with callouts for national compute programs: Brazil R$ 23.03 billion plan, EU 200 billion euro InvestAI goal with a 20 billion euro gigafactory fund, Saudi Arabia up to 500 MW, UAE 1 GW Stargate, India 38,231 GPUs, China 1.59 million PFLOPS, South Korea 260,000 GPUs, Japan at least 10 trillion yen to FY2030, United States 11.9 GW of listed frontier sites.
svg.text: National compute programs and their stated sizes
Official or primary statements, 2024 to 2026. Units differ by country, so no ranking is implied.
InvestAI: EUR 200 bn goal, EUR 20 bn gigafactory fund
HUMAIN: up to 500 MW over 5 years
Stargate UAE 1 GW inside a 5 GW campus
AI and chips: at least JPY 10 tn public support to FY2030
Africa: Cassava Technologies is deploying an NVIDIA-based AI factory in South Africa, with plans for Nigeria, Kenya, Egypt and Morocco (company statement; no capacity figures read).
